## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Miles' light summary screen sits dimmed behind a bottom sheet. The sheet starts as "Welcome to Miles": the runner app icon, a welcome paragraph, and a black "Get started" button. On tap, the same sheet grows taller and its contents rearrange into "Apple Health Sync": the icon gains a small red heart badge, the headline changes, two bullet rows appear explaining the data flow, and the button becomes "Continue".

## Motion spec
Pattern: bottom sheet content morph, ~700ms total.
- On tap, the sheet expands upward to its taller detent (spring stiffness 320 damping 28), the dim behind it deepening slightly.
- The welcome content fades and slides up out (200ms) as the permission content fades and slides up in (250ms, 50ms later) - a vertical handoff inside a stable sheet.
- The app icon persists through the morph, sliding to its new position as the heart badge pops on (spring stiffness 420 damping 18).
- The button's label crossfades from "Get started" to "Continue" while the button itself stays pinned at the sheet's bottom.

## Calibration
- One sheet, continuous corner radius - it grows, never dismisses and reopens.
- The icon is the visual anchor: same element, same size, new badge.

## Reduced motion
Sheet content crossfades; height animates.

## Don't miss
- The sheet's top edge moves but its bottom stays glued to the screen edge.
- The dimmed summary behind remains visible and static throughout.
